## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security / privacy

## Safety, privacy and cost

- [ ] No credentials, tokens or personal data are included.
- [ ] User data remains isolated.
- [ ] Persistent or external mutations still require exact owner approval.
- [ ] No paid service or external model call was enabled without explicit approval.
- [ ] Browser/network permissions were not broadened without security tests.
- [ ] Any new data collection, retention or provider routing is documented.

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests pass.
- [ ] Browser and egress-policy tests pass (if applicable).
- [ ] Frontend production build passes (if applicable).
- [ ] Container builds / Compose validation pass (if applicable).
- [ ] Documentation and roadmap updated.
